questions.prompt: GPIS D-02: totals 75, 70, 70, 65. What are the positions?
questions.why: 65 has three pupils ahead of it, so it is 4th. The tie shares 2nd.

wrong.0: That is dense ranking. It hides that three pupils are ahead.
wrong.2: Equal totals must share a position.
wrong.3: A tie shares the higher place: one pupil is ahead of them, so they are 2nd.

questions.prompt: GPIS D-02: totals 88, 88, 88, 60. What is the position of 60?
questions.why: Three pupils have a higher total: 1 + 3 = 4th.

wrong.1: Three pupils are ahead, not two.

questions.why: Without a compare function, items are compared as text: "10" < "100" < "9".

wrong.0: That needs a compare function: `(a, b) => a - b`.
wrong.1: That is number order, biggest first. It also needs a compare function.

questions.prompt: `const a = [3, 1]; const b = a; b.sort();` What is `a[0]` now?
options: An error, because a is const
questions.why: `b` is a second name for the same array. Sorting it sorts `a`.

wrong.1: `b = a` does not copy. Only `[...a]` would.
wrong.2: The array still has two items.
wrong.3: `const` stops giving `a` a new value, not changing the array.

questions.prompt: GPIS Q-07: subjects [80, null, 70]. Which total is used for ranking?
questions.why: A missing subject adds nothing, and the student still gets a position.

wrong.0: That is an average. The rule ranks on the total.
wrong.1: A blank does not poison the total.
wrong.2: Q-07 says the student still receives a position.

questions.prompt: Which tool turns a list of students into a list of their totals?
questions.why: `map` gives a new array of the same length, one new value per item.

wrong.0: `filter` keeps or drops items; it does not change them.
wrong.2: `reduce` gives one value, such as the sum.
wrong.3: `sort` changes the order, not the values.

questions.prompt: Find the mistake: `positions = sorted.map((s, i) => i + 1)`
questions.why: The index counts places in the list, not pupils with a higher total. 90, 90 would be 1st and 2nd.

wrong.2: The index starts at 0; that is why `+ 1` is there.

questions.prompt: GPIS D-04: a withdrawn pupil has the highest total in the class data. What is the position of the best active pupil?
options: No position until the withdrawn pupil is deleted
questions.why: Ranking covers active pupils only. Nobody's position moves because of a withdrawn pupil.

wrong.1: Nothing is deleted; the filter leaves the pupil out.
wrong.3: The withdrawn pupil has no position to share.
